originalTitle: Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: Here's Why
summary: Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) reached $73.17 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a -2.93% change compared to its last close.
content:
In the latest trading session, Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) closed at $73.17, marking a -2.93% move from the previous day. The stock's change was less than the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.46%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.56%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 0.45%.

Coming into today, shares of the defense contractor had gained 2.43% in the past month. In that same time, the Business Services sector gained 1.36%, while the S&P 500 gained 2%.

The investment community will be closely monitoring the performance of Booz Allen Hamilton in its forthcoming earnings report. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $1.43, showcasing a 4.03% downward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Meanwhile, the latest consensus estimate predicts the revenue to be $2.8 billion, indicating a 3.09% decrease compared to the same quarter of the previous year.

Looking at the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates suggest analysts are expecting earnings of $6.25 per share and revenue of $11.45 billion. These totals would mark changes of -3.99% and +2.08%, respectively, from last year.

Investors should also take note of any recent adjustments to analyst estimates for Booz Allen Hamilton. Recent revisions tend to reflect the latest near-term business trends. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Based on our research, we believe these estimate revisions are directly related to near-term stock moves. To exploit this, we've formed the Zacks Rank, a quantitative model that includes these estimate changes and presents a viable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, running from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), holds an admirable track record of superior performance, independently audited, with #1 stocks contributing an average annual return of +25% since 1988. The Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 0.56% higher within the past month. Booz Allen Hamilton presently features a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

With respect to valuation, Booz Allen Hamilton is currently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 12.07. This expresses a discount compared to the average Forward P/E of 16.11 of its industry.

One should further note that BAH currently holds a PEG ratio of 3.94. The PEG ratio bears resemblance to the frequently used P/E ratio, but this parameter also includes the company's expected earnings growth trajectory. As of the close of trade yesterday, the Consulting Services industry held an average PEG ratio of 1.06.

The Consulting Services industry is part of the Business Services sector. This industry, currently bearing a Zacks Industry Rank of 51, finds itself in the top 21% echelons of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the strength of our separate industry groups by calculating the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks contained within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 博思艾伦 (BAH) 股票随着市场上涨而下跌：原因如下
chineseSummary: 博思艾伦(BAH)最新交易日收盘价达到73.17美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨-2.93%。
chineseContent:
在最新的交易日中，博思艾伦 (BAH) 收于 73.17 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -2.93%。该股的涨幅低于标准普尔 500 指数 0.46% 的日涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 0.56%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.45%。

截至今天，这家国防承包商的股价在过去一个月上涨了 2.43%。与此同时，商业服务板块上涨 1.36%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 2%。

投资界将密切关注博思艾伦即将发布的收益报告的表现。该公司预计每股收益为 1.43 美元，较去年同期下降 4.03%。与此同时，最新的共识预测收入为28亿美元，较去年同期下降3.09%。

展望全年，Zacks 一致估计表明分析师预计每股收益为 6.25 美元，收入为 114.5 亿美元。与去年相比，这些总数将分别发生-3.99% 和+2.08% 的变化。

投资者还应注意分析师对博思艾伦咨询公司估计的近期调整。最近的修订往往反映最新的近期业务趋势。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

根据我们的研究，我们认为这些估计修正与近期股票走势直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们形成了 Zacks Rank，这是一个定量模型，其中包括这些估计变化并提供了一个可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有令人钦佩的卓越业绩记录，经过独立审计，自 1988 年以来#1 股票贡献的平均年回报率为 +25%。Zacks 共识 EPS 估计在过去一个月内上涨了 0.56%。博思艾伦汉密尔顿目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

就估值而言，Booz Allen Hamilton 目前的远期市盈率为 12.07。这与行业平均远期市盈率 16.11 相比有折扣。

还应该指出的是，BAH 目前的 PEG 比率为 3.94。 PEG比率与常用的市盈率相似，但该参数还包括公司的预期盈利增长轨迹。截至昨天收盘，咨询服务行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.06。

咨询服务行业是商业服务行业的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 51，在所有 250 多个行业中处于前 21% 的梯队。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算各行业组中包含的个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
